title: PixelKin - Title Theme (Long Dusk, Rising)
_note: EXCITING BATTLE-GAME title statement - reasoned from first principles to escape the 'nursery rhyme' trap. Nursery-rhyme = absence of tension on every axis (pure major I-IV-V, do-re-mi stepwise melody, on-beat square rhythm, bell timbre). Excitement = TENSION + DRIVE + WEIGHT, so: (1) A natural-minor / Aeolian key (A minor) with the epic i-bVI-bVII cadence (Am-F-G) and a HARMONIC-MINOR dominant (E major, raised G# leading tone) for dramatic pull; (2) real harmonic motion incl. a circle-of-fifths lift (Dm-G-C-F) in the heroic B-section; (3) a GALLOPING bass ostinato (long-short-short, the heroic/battle rhythm) plus a relentless pulse arpeggio for drive; (4) a wide, LEAPING chromatic melody (4th/5th/octave leaps, dramatic descents) that climbs to a high climax (C6/D6); (5) aggressive timbres - a cutting saw lead and brass stabs, NO bell. Structure: tense minor A (the heroic theme over the Aeolian vamp) -> triumphant B lift (circle of fifths up to the C-major peak) -> dramatic cadence that slams back to the top (E dominant -> Am). 150 BPM, A minor, 16-bar loop (~25.6s). Cohesive with the wild-battle theme (same A-minor heroic palette - the title previews the fight) and still nods to the Vesper rising-leap, here fragmented and heroic per the score's battle treatment. Renders on the chip engine for soundtrack cohesion. Original melody throughout (VISION.md).

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Heroic, leaping, chromatic - the opposite of stepwise do-re-mi. A: bold theme over the Am vamp, dotted rhythm, rising-4th/5th leaps and sharp descents, the harmonic-minor G# at the E cadence. B: a circle-of-fifths lift climbing to the C6/D6 climax, then a dramatic descent and an E-major (G# leading-tone) cadence that pulls the loop back to A.

tracks.name: arp

tracks.name: bass
tracks._note: GALLOPING ostinato - eighth + two sixteenths per beat (the long-short-short heroic/battle gallop), root per chord. This is the engine of the excitement; it never lets up. Roots: A A F G A F G E | D G C F D E A E, the E pedalling the dominant into the loop seam.

tracks.name: drums
tracks._note: Hard driving battle beat: kick on 1 & 3 with a push on the 'and of 3', snare on 2 & 4, hats on the eighths. Crash opens each section (A, the A-repeat, the B lift, the cadence); tom fills close each 8-bar half. Each bar = 8 eighths.
